_comment: The official Senso agent skills, as published to the Shipables registry from the senso-skills repository. src/commands/skills.ts must list exactly these. Maintained by hand: a mismatch means either the registry moved or the CLI's list did. These superseded the five workflow skills; senso-evaluate-remediate is retired (a tombstone in the registry) and `senso setup` removes it. senso-onboarding joined at 2.0.0, the first run before any key exists.
